agents.blurb: Web and data search; the daily hunt scans the tradable universe.
Draft a payment request (requires approval before execution).
Create a tracked task with owner and due date.
Store an outcome in long-term vector memory.
Execute a natural-language query against the data layer.
Investigate a QA failure and propose a supervised fix (issue #162); run the scheduled QA sweep (issue #1655).
Provider-neutral trading competency (issue #291): stock/options screening and approval-gated trading across registered broker providers.
A materialized approved chain goal (issue #1517): fired only through the governed predicate, executed by the chain lane.
Build the day's social drafts and publish them under the channel gating (issue #1077); pipeline:social-daily runs feed → generate → deliver as one scheduled firing (issue #1224).

SessionStore resource rollup, cap alert, and dashboard comparison (issue #1819): daily UTC rollup, hourly 70%-of-cap alert, and the instrumented-vs-dashboard comparison report, all as ScheduledAgent goals.

Stored index-list refresh (issue #1980, follow-up to #1852; extended by #2962): weekly Wikipedia refresh of Dow / S&P 500 / S&P 100 / Nasdaq-100 / S&P 400 / the 11 GICS sectors and daily ETF-holdings refresh of Russell 2000 / Russell 1000 / Russell 3000, both as ScheduledAgent goals on the existing tick.

Monthly Autopilot policy-envelope evaluation (issue #4411): a dry-run check of the live envelope against live limits and live account state, once a month, as a ScheduledAgent goal — never places orders.

jobs.label: Opportunity hunt
jobs.note: The seeded opportunity-hunt goal's operation (daily 07:00, enabled). Unlike #1655's qa.run_sweep (descriptor-only), this operation has an executor: src/services/opportunityHunt.ts.

jobs.label: Store an outcome in long-term memory
Daily QA sweep
jobs.note: The built-in goals config daily-qa-sweep operation. createJob is descriptor-only, so registration is the complete op-registry fix — no executor is added here, and no sweep implementation is claimed.

jobs.label: Execute a materialized chain
jobs.note: A materialized-chain marker, NOT an orchestrator job operation. ScheduledAgent handles it in its own onCron branch; the catalog entry exists so a materialized goals-list entry is a valid goal. It is listed in the planner prompt like the social marker operations; it is not a leg an orchestrator plan executes.

jobs.label: Daily social post
jobs.note: NOT an orchestrator job. ScheduledAgent executes it directly through the social goal executor; the catalog entry exists so addGoal accepts the operation and the dashboard can list it.

jobs.label: Social daily pipeline
jobs.note: NOT an orchestrator job. ScheduledAgent executes it through the pipeline executor (feed → generate → deliver in one firing); the entry exists so addGoal accepts the pipeline operation. The stage operations (social.feed, social.generate, social.deliver) are deliberately NOT catalog entries: stages are not schedulable goals.

jobs.label: SessionStore daily resource rollup
jobs.note: NOT an orchestrator job. ScheduledAgent executes it directly through the resource goal handlers (the social.publish precedent); the catalog entry exists so addGoal accepts the operation and the dashboard can list it.

jobs.label: Index-list refresh (Wikipedia)
jobs.note: NOT an orchestrator job. ScheduledAgent executes it directly through the refresh job (the social.publish / resource.* precedent); the catalog entry exists so addGoal accepts the operation and the dashboard can list it.

jobs.label: Autopilot monthly evaluation
jobs.note: NOT an orchestrator job. ScheduledAgent executes it directly through the evaluate path (the social.publish / resource.* / index.* precedent); the catalog entry exists so addGoal accepts the operation and the dashboard can list it.

jobs.description: Screens the selected live universe against E*TRADE option chains and generates a report.
jobs.label: Autonomous Options Analysis

jobs.description: Screens the selected live stock universe with E*TRADE quotes and generates a PDF report.
jobs.label: Autonomous Market Screen (Stocks)

jobs.description: Re-runs saved discovery views (symbol, thesis, target) captured from the discovery panel against the live E*TRADE chain and stores the ranked results.
jobs.label: Saved-View Strategy Discovery
Autonomous Goal Screen
jobs.note: Goal-driven screens are schedulable through the one schedule store (Consolidation C1). API-creatable, but not offered in the create form: the form offers the three screening jobs only.

jobs.label: Pipeline Job Schedule
jobs.note: A job defined from the externalized definition spec is schedulable through the same store; the callback runs that engine job by id. API-creatable, but not offered in the create form.

jobs.label: Async job
jobs.note: The async-job plumbing. Internal-only: armed by the agent itself, never through the create route; a delayed job of this callback reads queued.

jobs.label: Expire stale order draft
jobs.note: Order-draft expiry. Internal-only: armed by the agent itself, never through the create route.

jobs.label: Scheduled reminder
jobs.note: The NLQ-armed reminder callback, not REST-creatable.

jobs.label: Workflow stage
jobs.note: A stage schedule fires a workflow stage; it is a platform mechanism, not a family, so it reads system.

jobs.label: Broker token renewal
jobs.note: The heartbeat due-check renews the broker tokens daily (03:00 UTC). The unified-store record is derived, not stored; the ledger jobId its runs join on is its dispatch cron.

jobs.label: Storage retention pass
jobs.note: The heartbeat due-check runs the retention pass daily (04:00 UTC). The unified-store record is derived, not stored; the ledger jobId its runs join on is its dispatch cron.

jobs.label: Nightly options research
jobs.note: The daily options-research run (POST /research/scheduled-tick), weekdays at/after 21:00 UTC, riding the every-30-minute tick. The unified-store record is derived, not stored; the record id doubles as the ledger jobId.

jobs.label: IV history collection
jobs.note: The system-armed daily IV collection, weekdays 22:15 UTC. The record id is its alarm id (the #3123 screen precedent); the catalogue id is the collection origin, named once here.

jobs.label: Stale ledger task sweep
jobs.note: The stale-ledger-task sweep, armed once per user on a 6-hour interval. The record id doubles as the ledger jobId its runs join on.

jobs.label: Stale async job sweep
jobs.note: The stale-async-job sweep, armed once per instance on a 15-minute interval. The record id doubles as the ledger jobId its runs join on.

jobs.label: Missed-schedule watchdog
jobs.note: The missed-schedule watchdog, armed once per instance on the 15-minute tick. Its runs join on the pre-existing heartbeat job id (schedule-watchdog-heartbeat), not this id.

jobs.label: Ticker push feed
jobs.note: The one shared TickerAgent feed. Interval-driven from live feed state, so it carries no default cron; the record id is stable and the SDK alarm id rides as alarmId.
